admission.authority: direct user continuation of the main-backed BRC multiplier transport program
admission.reason: Strict extension of exact multiplier root/remainder transport: safe odd-N mod-4 multiplier elimination, structural same-parity factor-pair priority, and exact direct m=1 to target-m BRC jumps.

methods.name: BRC prioritized direct multiplier jump
capabilities: exact elimination of m=2 mod 4 for odd-N difference-of-squares scans
direct exact BRC transport from the retained m=1 root/remainder state to arbitrary target m<=100
proved at-most-11 odd-basin corrections for direct jumps
candidate ordering that does not require materializing all intermediate multiplier states
methods.core_law: For odd N, m congruent 2 mod 4 is impossible as a difference-of-squares multiplier. For any target t<=100, the dyadic predictor floor(2^B(sqrt(t)-1)) applied to the retained m=1 BRC root places floor(sqrt(tN)) at most 11 odd square-basin crossings above the candidate; the exact remainder update uses R+(t-1)N-d(2J+d).
methods.hard_boundary: The mod-4 skip and direct jump are exact; the same-parity factor-pair ranking is only a finite empirically useful heuristic and is not claimed optimal. Multiplier-Fermat/Lehman difference-of-squares remains classical prior art. No asymptotic factorization speedup, no theorem about semiprime ratio distributions, and no Foundation promotion are claimed.
